# Code of conduct

This project follows the
[Contributor Covenant, version 2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/).

## Reporting

Report a problem privately. Open the **Security** tab of this repository,
select **Report a vulnerability**, and start the title with `Conduct:`. Only
the maintainer can read the report.

The maintainer reads every report and acts on it as the Covenant's
enforcement guidelines describe.
